blocks.text: Globe Telecom is strengthening its investments in mobile connectivity, fiber broadband and enterprise digital services as demand for reliable internet continues to grow across the Philippines, including emerging business centers in Cebu and the wider Visayas and Mindanao. During its Globe 3Q/9M 2026 Media Briefing held via Zoom on November 11, 2026, the company reported ₱129 billion in service revenues for the first nine months of 2026, up 6% year-on-year, reflecting growth across its mobile, home broadband and corporate data businesses. For Cebu, where businesses increasingly depend on digital connectivity to support daily operations and customer services, these developments highlight the […]...
